name: kmacmcfarlane
description: Claude Code plugin marketplace for Kyle McFarlane — dev tooling and reusable skills.

plugins.name: kit-dev
plugins.description: Maintain this plugin kit: create skills, update the kit, start projects from templates, factor analysis (external: claude-templates; claude-plugins; claude-sandbox; claude-expertise; claude-kit, optional; soft: dev-flow; work-items; create-repo).

plugins.name: context-guard
plugins.description: Survive the context window: a gate before compaction, checkpoints, rehydration and a token-spend report (soft: statusline-hub; work-items; dev-flow; research).

plugins.name: statusline
plugins.description: An always-on status line footer: context left, plan usage, model and session name (requires statusline-hub; soft: context-guard).

plugins.name: statusline-hub
plugins.description: The shared status-line slot: a dispatcher, a hook registry, and a usage record other plugins read (soft: statusline; context-guard).

plugins.name: dev-flow
plugins.description: Plan before you code, run deep research fan-outs, and keep a librarian that owns a repo's work (agents: scribe, scout, implementer, implementer-critical, implementer-deep, planner, planner-deep, reviewer, reviewer-light, cross-checker, cross-checker-deep) (soft: work-items; context-guard; statusline-hub; operator-interaction; research; sandbox; kit-dev; create-repo; ownership; external, soft: claude-analytics).

plugins.name: research
plugins.description: Research a subject into sourced, verified findings, fact-checked answers and a knowledge base, with a RESEARCH.md map (agents: research-lane, research-lane-deep, research-verifier) (soft: work-items; statusline-hub; operator-interaction; context-guard; dev-flow).

plugins.name: work-items
plugins.description: Repo-durable work items with the wi CLI, a cross-repo review, and the work-source provider interface (soft: statusline-hub; operator-interaction).

plugins.name: chat
plugins.description: Conversational skills — structured product research and purchase recommendations.

plugins.name: sandbox
plugins.description: Set up and troubleshoot claude-sandbox containers, with a guard that keeps edits off the main checkout (external: claude-sandbox).

plugins.name: create-repo
plugins.description: Start a new repo for a thread of work, with an agent session launched on it (external, soft: claude-sandbox; soft: sandbox; dev-flow; kit-dev; operator-interaction).

plugins.name: operator-interaction
plugins.description: How agents put what they need in front of you: decision cards, an answer page, and plain names (external, soft: claude.ai Artifacts; node).

plugins.name: ownership
plugins.description: Declare each repo's ownership claim in CLAIM.md: what it owns, what is not ours, its boundaries (soft: work-items; dev-flow; kit-dev; operator-interaction).

plugins.name: ralph
plugins.description: Unattended agent loops over a backlog, with backlog.yaml as the default work source (external, required: claude-sandbox; soft: sandbox; work-items).
